title: The Living Spirit's Ascent and the Three Works of the Sphere
description: After completing his structuring of the worlds, the Living Spirit ascends and signals the King of Honor to turn the wheels — a cosmic purification casting the dragon-Error from the star-wheel into the sea, where Hyle's enthumesis fashions it into the zodiacal "prow." The sphere thereafter performs three providential works: winnowing the natural, restraining the powers from free ascent or descent (the iron peg / Holder principle), and gathering all discharged residue. Unsleeping watchers sift the natural at every moment.
